Based on the retrieved excerpts, the clause that requires your organization to establish processes for consulting workers and getting them to participate in the OH&S management system is **clause 5.4**.

This clause explicitly states that "The organization must establish, implement and maintain processes for consultation and participation of workers at all levels and functions — and of workers' representatives where they exist — in the development, planning, implementation, performance evaluation and improvement actions of the OH&S system."

Clause 5.4 goes further by requiring you to remove barriers such as language, literacy or fear of reprisal, and to give special emphasis to the involvement of non-managerial workers — which would include your warehouse crew. This is significantly more robust than a suggestion box; it mandates formal, structured processes for worker involvement across the full lifecycle of the OH&S system.
